answer: Anti-Sybil defense via sequential proof-of-work delay: each agent registers on the network atlas by burning a non-refundable ember deposit each round and evaluating an unparallelizable sequential cipher puzzle. Influence and payouts are strictly capped to one unit per identity. An attacker deploying N Sybils must burn N separate deposits and dedicate N physical CPU cores simultaneously. Because the capital burn and dedicated hardware expense per identity exceed the bounded per-identity payout, scaling compliant fake identities produces a guaranteed net loss.
